$comment: Package-repo authoring config for the Surge XT WebVST. This is NOT an SDK type: the SDK's
ManifestAuthorConfig only carries { wasm, packageId, version, modulePath, curation }.
scripts/build.ts (Task 5) probes build/surgext-webvst.wasm with the SDK's generateManifest(),
then MERGES this file's `curation`, plus the per-class `programs` and top-level `artifacts`
produced by scripts/pack-presets.ts, into the manifest and validateManifest()s the result.
Task 4 produces this config, the packer, and their tests only -- no plugin.json, no archive.
Class identity, asserted here so Task 5 can check the module probe against it. Every value
matches src/surge_webvst.h: kClassUid, kClassName, kClassVendor, and kClassKindInstrument (1u).
There is exactly one class (kClassCount = 1u) at index 0 (kClassIndex = 0u).
class.name: Surge XT

$comment: Presentation for the single generator class, plus the per-voice track parameters an
instrument receives. Note + Velocity mirror the host's WEBVST_NOTE_PARAMETERS contract:
a `note` column and a `byte` velocity column, added to every instrument regardless of
which global parameters the module exposes.
generator.name: Surge XT
generator.description: Surge XT, the hybrid synthesizer by the Surge Synth Team, conveyed under GPLv3 behind the Prometheos WebVST ABI v1.

$comment: Category/Preset program declaration. The concrete `programs` block on class 0 and the
top-level `artifacts` array are GENERATED by scripts/pack-presets.ts from the pinned
vendor/surge factory patches (641 presets across 17 categories) -- packPresets() ->
toManifestPrograms() / toManifestArtifacts(). Do not hand-maintain preset lists here.
The two generator globals a host adds for preset recall (Category, Program) are DERIVED
from the merged block, not embedded, so they can never drift from the packed data:
Category: byte, 0 .. (categories.length - 1), noValue 255, default 0
Program:  byte/word, 0 .. (max entries in any one category - 1), noValue 255/65535, default 0
programs.concatenationOrder: category directory name ascending (ordinal .sort()), then each category's .fxp relative path ascending (ordinal .sort(), recursive so Tutorials/<sub>/*.fxp is included)

artifact.staging: package/presets/<category slug>.bin  (git-ignored; regenerated by `pnpm run pack-presets` and by the .webvst archive build)

entries.name: <28-byte PRGNAME field, verbatim>
entries.offset: <uint: byte offset of the sub3 blob within presets/<slug>.bin>
entries.size: <uint: byte length of the sub3 blob>

artifacts.sha256: <lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the concatenated sub3 blobs>
